items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: I was working with the Midriffs... They had Ellick Burrell. Ellick Burrell. Playing piano. He's now Duke Burrell.

ctx.x: So what band were you working with at this time? You had a band named the Midriffs, didn't you? It wasn't none of my band.

I was working with the Midriffs. Who was in that band? That was George Miller. He just recently died. He had three or four months ago. Maybe five. And Boots Alexis. Now what did he play? Oh, Boots? Yeah. He played the drums. And George Wilson, what did he play? He played an upright bass and he sung. Who else was in that band? They had Ellick Burrell. Ellick Burrell. Playing piano. He's now Duke Burrell. Duke Burrell. Yeah, he's in L.A. He changed his name. Yeah. No more Ellick. He's Duke Burrell now. And who else?
And you played piano? Well, after I joined the group.
